install:
if ! (command -v redis-server >/dev/null 2>&1 && dpkg -s postgresql >/dev/null 2>&1); then sudo apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql postgresql-contrib redis-server; fi
pnpm install
pnpm db:generate
start:
sudo service postgresql start
sudo service redis-server start
